page.layout: One full-page engraving: a crucifixion scene printed in a rectangular plate in the centre of the page. No printed text on the page.
page.notes: Engraving only: a woodcut or copper-engraved plate of the crucifixion of Christ, with the cross, the body of Christ with arms outstretched, the titulus at the top of the cross not legible, a landscape with buildings and figures in the background. Surrounding area is paper and scan background, with a dark shadow at the bottom edge. No words, page number, running head or signature are printed.
